candidates.change_summary: Replace `return _owner;` with `return address(0);` so owner() always returns the zero address.
Replace `return _owner;` with `return _msgSender();` so owner() returns the caller instead of the stored owner.
Replace `return _owner;` with `return address(this);` so owner() returns the contract's own address.
Insert `_owner = address(0);` before the return so owner() always returns the zero address.
Delete the _transferOwnership(newOwner) call so owner() is never updated when transferOwnership is called.
Replace _transferOwnership(newOwner) with _transferOwnership(_msgSender()) so ownership is transferred to the caller instead of newOwner.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier check so any caller can invoke transferOwnership and change the owner.
Replace the assignment to rewardDistributor with an assignment of address(0).
Replace the assignment to rewardDistributor with an assignment of the migrator address.
Delete the assignment statement so rewardDistributor keeps its previous value.
